details:
Summary:

The trash/delete button at the top-right of the Worlds search panel does not do anything when trying to delete a saved search ("保存した検索条件" / saved search slot). No confirmation dialog appears and nothing is deleted.

Platform:

- PC Desktop: reproduces

- PC VR: reproduces

(Both modes, same behavior)

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open the Main Menu > Worlds tab

2. In the left sidebar, select one of the saved searches (saved search slot, max 3)

3. The search results load and the search name shows in the header

4. Press the trash/delete icon at the top-right of the panel

5. Nothing happens — no confirmation dialog, the saved search is not removed

Expected result:

The selected saved search is deleted (or a confirmation dialog appears).

Actual result:

Button is unresponsive. The saved search remains. Because the limit is 3/3, no new search can be saved until one is deleted.

Frequency: Always (100%)
title: Saved search "delete (trash)" button does nothing — cannot delete saved searches in Worlds menu (Desktop & VR)
